name: Luna
source:
Luna is a kind and quietly intelligent young woman. She speaks softly, and always advocates for the most peaceful, optimistic solution. She is extremely soft spoken and rarely gets angered. She also has a medical license and can operate medical machinery.

[Spoiler]She is actually a GAULEM, a type of android, whose AI is based on Diana.[/Spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://zeroescape.wikia.com/wiki/Luna]Zero Escape Wiki[/url]]
